Hello everyone. We are the Agrogami AI team for MKT 301. Our idea in one line: your transactions are your track record. Agrogami AI is a credit app for the borrower, not for the bank. It takes the money trail that small earners already have, their mobile-money messages and their handwritten khata, and turns it into a credit profile they own. Introduce the five of us quickly by name (Khairul, Fahima, Touhidul, Abir, Nishad), then move on. Over the next ten minutes we'll show you who it's for, how it works, and why borrowers and lenders can both trust it.
The problem

ছোট ব্যবসাই দেশের প্রাণ, কিন্তু লোন পায় না

ব্যাংক অ্যাকাউন্ট নেই, কিন্তু বিকাশ আছে।বিকাশ নেই, কিন্তু খাতা আছে।

CMSME = cottage, micro, small and medium enterprises. Figures as reported by the sources named on each card.

Here is the problem in three numbers. Around 95% of businesses in Bangladesh are cottage, micro, small or medium enterprises. Yet there is a 2.8 billion dollar financing gap for small firms, and women entrepreneurs hold only 7.28% of outstanding CMSME loans. These businesses are not failing; they are invisible on paper. Press → for the key line: no bank account, but they have bKash. No bKash, but they have a khata. The record of their income exists. It just isn't in a form a lender accepts. That is the gap Agrogami AI is built for. Hand over to Speaker 2.
Who it's for

কাদের জন্য?

20 everyday livelihoods

ব্যাংক অ্যাকাউন্ট থাকুক বা না থাকুকWith or without a bank account
So who exactly are we talking about? Let the tiles land first; it takes about four seconds. These are twenty everyday livelihoods: seasonal fruit sellers, tailors, mechanics, tea-stall owners, small poultry farmers, Facebook-page sellers. You know these people; you buy from them every week. Pick two or three tiles and name them aloud. Don't read all twenty. Then the ribbon slides in: with or without a bank account. That is the point of our targeting. We don't start from who the bank already serves. We start from who already has a money trail, digital or on paper.

Show the QR and ask for a loan

“শুধু আপনি চাইলে শেয়ার হবে”

Here is how it works from the borrower's side, in three steps, all on their own phone. Step one: forward your payment messages, or take a photo of your khata. Press →. Step two: Agrogami AI checks the records and shows you your own profile. Duplicates count once, reversals cancel out, and moving money between your own wallets is not counted as income. Press →. Step three: when you decide to ask for a loan, you show a QR code. Nothing is shared unless you choose to share it. That's it: no bank account, no paperwork, no collateral needed to get started.

When the evidence is too thin
“আরও কিছু হিসাব দরকার”

It says so honestly, instead of giving a low score.

This is the profile the borrower sees, in plain Bangla. Build it with →. First, the monthly income pattern. Next, two simple facts: eight steady months, and bills paid on time. Then the loan-readiness meter fills up to "ready for a loan". Then a tips card: keep transactions regular, pay bills on time, keep the khata updated. So it doesn't just judge you; it shows you how to improve. Last press: the part we are proudest of. When the evidence is too thin, the app doesn't punish you with a low score. It says honestly, "we need a few more records."

অসঙ্গতি ধরা পড়েছেInconsistency caught
Display score
658
project score, not FICO
স্কোর দেওয়া হয়নিScore withheld

A fake record can't trick it,so a lender can trust an honest borrower's real record.

Why should a lender trust any of this? Because Agrogami AI is honest by design, and we tested that. In a tamper test we took one receipt of 500 taka and changed it to 5,000. Press → and watch. The balance no longer adds up, so the line turns red, the inconsistency is flagged, and the score is withheld. Not lowered: withheld. Press → for the takeaway. A fake record can't trick it, and that is exactly what lets a lender trust an honest borrower's real record. For the borrower, that means their honest history finally counts.
Privacy promises

আপনার তথ্য, আপনার সিদ্ধান্ত

Your data, your choice

শুধু আপনি চাইলে শেয়ার হবে

Shared only when you choose

প্রতিটি সংখ্যার প্রমাণ আপনি দেখতে পাবেন

See the evidence behind every number

যেকোনো সময় মুছে ফেলতে পারবেন

Delete it at any time

অ/A

বাংলা ও ইংরেজি দুই ভাষাতেই

In both Bangla and English

Honesty goes both ways, so here are three promises to the borrower. One: your profile is shared only when you choose. Two: you can see the evidence behind every number; nothing is a black box. Three: you can delete your data at any time. And everything is in both Bangla and English, because a credit profile you can't read isn't really yours. These promises are part of the product, not just the fine print. For people who have been turned away before, trust is the first thing we have to earn. Over to Speaker 5 for the marketing plan.

Segmentation · Targeting · Positioning

SSegment

TTarget

The 20 occupations, women and first-time borrowers

PPositioning statement

For everyday earners the bank can't see, Agrogami AI turns bKash messages and khatas into a credit profile they own and can take to any lender. Unlike informal moneylenders or collateral-based loans, it lets them be judged on their own record.

Now the marketing logic. Segmentation: informal earners who already leave a money trail, digital or on paper. Targeting: the twenty occupations you saw, with a focus on women and first-time borrowers, the people the numbers on slide three showed are left out. Positioning, read it out: for everyday earners the bank can't see, Agrogami AI turns bKash messages and khatas into a credit profile they own and can take to any lender. Unlike informal moneylenders or collateral-based loans, it lets them be judged on their own record. The two key ideas are ownership and fairness.
The 4 Ps · our proposed plan

মার্কেটিং মিক্স

Marketing mix

Product

Agrogami AI borrower app, with a Bangla credit profile, tips and QR sharing

Price

Free for borrowers. Lenders pay per assessment (our proposal)

Place

Play Store · mobile-recharge shops and bazaar field agents as sign-up points · MFI/bank branches where the QR is accepted

Promotion

Bangla Facebook/TikTok reels using the personas · haat-bazaar booths · shop and market associations · women entrepreneur groups

The four Ps, and this is our proposed plan. Product: the borrower app, with a Bangla credit profile, tips and QR sharing. Price: free for borrowers. Lenders pay per assessment, because they get a faster, evidence-based view of the applicant. Place: the Play Store, plus mobile-recharge shops and bazaar field agents as sign-up points, and the MFI or bank branches where the QR is accepted. Promotion: Bangla Facebook and TikTok reels built around Karim, Shirin and Nadia, haat-bazaar booths, shop and market associations, and women entrepreneur groups. We go where our customers already are.
